description: Shell and tube heat exchanger manufacturer in Coimbatore: engineered to order. Share both fluids, flows and temperatures for sizing and a quotation.
card: Heat exchangers built to order to transfer heat between two fluids without mixing them.
lede: A shell and tube heat exchanger transfers heat between two fluids without mixing them: one flows through a bundle of tubes, the other around the tubes inside the shell. Win Equipments builds them to order, sized from your fluids, flows and temperatures.
needs: Both fluids and their properties (water, oil, process fluid)
Inlet and required outlet temperatures on each side
Allowable pressure drop and connection sizes

faqs.q: Why is there no standard model table?
faqs.a: These units are engineered to order around your duty, so we size and quote each one from your requirement rather than publishing a fixed model list. Send your requirement and our engineers will reply with a recommended configuration.
